title: Sweet Spot Golf Club x Flyin' Iris
metaDescription: A proposal prepared for Evan Kiefer, Sweet Spot Golf Club, by Flyin' Iris.
eyebrow: Prepared for Evan Kiefer, Sweet Spot Golf Club
headline: No Off-Season.
subhead: Cinematic brand films and photography built around Wisconsin's first public indoor short game area, delivered before your fall season begins.

packages.label: Essentials
features: One evening production with Sierra & Sean, all in a single visit
Your main brand film, 30 to 60 seconds, delivered horizontal and vertical
Indoor drone flythrough shots woven through your film
Licensed music and cinematic color grade
One revision round, delivered within 14 days

packages.label: Signature
features: A full evening production with Sierra & Sean
Your main brand film, 60 to 90 seconds, delivered horizontal and vertical
Walkthrough film, 45 to 60 seconds: a front door to bunker tour
2 more vertical edits: short game feature and walkthrough teaser
Website hero film: a short silent loop for the top of your homepage
40 edited photos, including portraits of you
Licensed music and cinematic color grade
One revision round, delivered within 14 days

usageLine: Both options include full commercial usage rights for Sweet Spot Golf Club across web and social.
nextItems: Quick-strike verticals. Your pitch to camera, a winter membership push, a December gift card spot. $200 to $300 each
"Your First Visit" film. For the person who has never touched a simulator. Your whole brand, as one film. $350 to $500
Mid-winter refresh, half day. We return in January when the place is full: fresh content to carry you to spring. $750 to $1,000
nextClosing: Nothing to decide now. Tell us which of these sparks something.

timeline.body: Pay in full or 50% to lock your date
One closed-day evening, week of Aug 3 or Aug 10

agreementTitle: Production Agreement: Sweet Spot Golf Club x Flyin' Iris.

agreementClauses.text: the package selected above, produced in one on-site session at Sweet Spot Golf Club, West Allis, WI.
pay in full today, or 50% today to reserve the date with the balance due on final delivery. All prices plus 5.9% WI sales tax.
one complimentary reschedule with at least 72 hours notice.
all films and photos delivered within 14 days of the shoot date, one revision round included; we want you happy with it.

Sweet Spot Golf Club receives full usage rights to all delivered films and photos, across any channel, however you like. A social tag of Flyin' Iris is appreciated but never required. Flyin' Iris retains the right to use the films, photos, and all material captured at the session in its own portfolio and marketing.
By checking the box and completing payment, you accept these terms.

successBody: Payment received. Sierra & Sean will reach out to confirm your shoot evening and everything that comes next.
cancelBody: Take your time. Everything here stays ready whenever you are.
